label: Japan Location
description: Japanese places beloved as anime key-visual settings — real locations, usable photorealistically or stylized. Tagged 'anime' for genre-filtered templates.

items.name: shrine-steps
items.text: A long stone stairway climbing to a hilltop Shinto shrine, flanked by weathered vermilion torii gates and stone lanterns under overhanging maples.
items.text_short: stone steps to a torii shrine

items.name: school-rooftop
items.text: A high-school rooftop behind wire safety fencing, water tank and ventilation units casting long shadows, the town spreading out far below.

items.name: rural-train-crossing
items.text: A single-track railway crossing in the countryside, striped barrier arms raised, rice paddies stretching to distant blue mountains.

items.name: konbini-glow
items.text: A small convenience store spilling bright fluorescent light onto the pavement of a sleepy suburban street, vending machines humming beside the entrance.

items.name: shotengai-arcade
items.text: A covered shopping arcade lined with small family shops, paper lanterns and hand-painted signs hanging beneath the arched glass roof.

items.name: hydrangea-alley
items.text: A narrow residential alley in the rainy season, blooming blue hydrangeas crowding the walls, wet flagstones mirroring the sky.

items.name: seaside-station
items.text: A tiny unmanned railway platform right beside the sea, a single bench facing the sparkling water across a low fence.

items.name: bamboo-grove-path
items.text: A walking path through a towering bamboo grove, green stalks converging overhead into filtered emerald light.

items.name: onsen-town-lane
items.text: A lantern-lit lane of a mountain onsen town, steam drifting from bathhouse vents past wooden ryokan facades.

items.name: tokyo-backstreet
items.text: A cluttered Tokyo backstreet of stacked signage, air-conditioner units, potted plants and tangled power lines overhead.

items.name: torii-over-water
items.text: A great vermilion torii gate standing in shallow tidal water, mirrored perfectly on the wet flats.

items.name: castle-and-sakura
items.text: A white-walled Japanese castle keep rising above a moat, framed by clouds of cherry blossom in full bloom.
